args.prompt: Thumb jerk, then SLOW's finger rises. Same donut shop: FAST jerks a thumb over his shoulder toward SLOW, who sits alone at a back table with his notebook and a black coffee, slowly raising one finger. Camera: Deep focus, FAST foreground, SLOW background. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, saturated colors, energetic limited animation with smear frames, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
